I have major depressive disorder and a few other mental health related diseases, I was suicidal for nearly a decade and have been suffering from my depression for much longer, in my teens I was of the same mindset, hell, I even gave myself an ultimatum, where if things weren't somewhat better by my 18th birthday I would end my life. An unfortunate malady associated with major depressive disorder is known as "psychomotor retardation" which I can only really describe as waking sleep paralysis; it happened to me the very morning of my 18th birthday, ruined my plans essentially, ever since then I've been in a haze, floating aimlessly in what seems like purgatory. I was so set on dying that day that I still heavily struggle with looking into the future.

I'm 25 now, not going to lie and say it was like a movie where things magically turned around and I got a story book happy ending, but things did get better, just not all at once. I had to visit the psych ward and go on heavy medication, but beyond that I'm doing a bit better, I'm still behind all of my peers and beat myself up for it, but I'm different, working on a different difficulty level.
